name: Blood
description: Vitality, Kinship, Sacrifice, Lineage, Power. Blood remembers. Blood binds. Blood pays the price. Hemomancy — the Crimson Art — turns the body into both fuel and focus: terrifying power, bought with vitality, identity, or lineage. Every drop carries the full record of a life, and whoever holds that drop holds a thread to its owner.

minor.name: Thinned
minor.card: its speed is halved as its blood runs slow

major.name: Blood-locked
major.card: Restrained — its blood refuses to let it move

severe.name: Seized
severe.card: Paralyzed; its blood answers you, not it

cost.text: All Blood Magic takes a toll. As you draw a seal with Blood as its Core, you lose hit points equal to five times the slot level. The loss can't be reduced or prevented, and temporary hit points don't pay it. You may take 1 level of Exhaustion instead.
cost.card: The Toll — lose 5 × {SLOT} HP as you draw (temp HP can't pay it) · or take 1 Exhaustion instead

mastery.title: Blood Magic
mastery.text: Whoever attunes to Blood begins to master the Crimson Art. These abilities are yours whether or not a seal is drawn; the level beside each is when it wakes.

traits.name: Blood Samples
traits.text: A creature your Blood seal damages — or one who offers it willingly — can leave you a sample: a drop you draw off as the seal lands. You keep up to your Proficiency Bonus samples fresh at a time. A sample is a Blood Component: spells and seals that call for a creature's blood can use it, hexes bound with it can't be traced back to you, and a curse bound with it binds to its owner's true self — it ends only with Greater Restoration and the destruction of the sample.
traits.card: Take a sample from anything your Blood seal damages · hold {PB} · hexes with it are untraceable, curses with it bind to the true self

traits.name: Blood Echo
traits.text: All blood carries fragments of ancestral memory. In a 1-hour ritual you may drain a sample to commune with its echo: an Arcana or History check — DC 10 for fresh blood, up to 25 for the ancient — reveals a family secret, a hidden magical talent, a forgotten language, or a suppressed memory. Curses ride the echo too: a creature can be born under the weight of an ancestor's crime, and you can read it there.
traits.card: 1-hr ritual: drain a sample — Arcana or History reveals a family secret, a talent, a lost language or a buried memory

traits.name: Blood Debt
traits.text: Seal a Blood Debt with a willing creature through mutual bleeding (1 minute). While it holds, once per short or long rest either of you may use a reaction to take the damage the other just took; either of you may serve as the other's Source of Magic; and a betrayal triggers the Blood Curse — both of you take necrotic damage equal to 90% of your hit point maximum and gain 3 levels of Exhaustion. A creature that holds more than one Blood Debt begins to be corrupted, toward becoming Bloodbound.
traits.card: A Blood Debt with a willing creature — 1/rest either takes the other's damage, each is the other's Source of Magic · betrayal: both take 90% max HP and 3 Exhaustion

traits.name: Blood Runes
traits.text: Instead of releasing a Blood seal, carve it into a Blood Rune on a surface, an object, or a creature: 10 minutes per slot level, with the use, the slot and the toll spent as you carve. The rune holds the seal until it is triggered or destroyed — by touch, by a timer, when a linked creature bleeds, by a command word, or by your bonus action within 300 feet — and the seal resolves then, with its one roll. You keep up to your Proficiency Bonus runes. Pay 5 more hit points per slot level while carving and it can be triggered from anywhere on the same plane.
traits.card: Carve a Blood seal into a rune (10 min per slot) — it waits for touch, a timer, blood, a word, or your bonus action within 300 ft · {PB} runes · +5 HP per slot: trigger it anywhere on the plane

offensive.name: Blood-Surge
offensive.description: Pour more of yourself in. The magic drinks the price.

tiers.text: The damage becomes Sanguine — the target's own blood turns on it. Pour more of yourself in as you draw: for every 5 hit points you lose, the effect gains one additional damage die, up to your Proficiency Bonus in dice.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Sanguine · lose 5 HP per extra die as you draw, up to {PB} dice

tiers.text: The price buys more: up to twice your Proficiency Bonus in dice, and while you are at half your hit points or lower, every 5 hit points buys two dice.
tiers.card: Up to 2 × {PB} dice · at half HP or lower, each 5 HP buys two

damage.extraDice: 1 per 5 HP lost (2 at half HP or lower), max 2×PB

tiers.text: Exsanguinate. A creature that is hit or fails bleeds out: at the start of each of its turns it takes 2d10 sanguine damage, and you regain hit points equal to what it takes. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Constitution saving throw against your Verum DC, ending the bleeding on a success. A creature without blood is unaffected.
tiers.card: EXSANGUINATE — 2d10 sanguine at the start of each of their turns, and you regain what it takes · Con save {DC} at the end of each turn stops it

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.escape: Constitution save at the end of each of its turns

tiers.text: Blood Moon. As you draw, you may pay half your current hit points: the effect's damage dice are doubled, and every creature it damages leaves you a sample.
tiers.card: BLOOD MOON — pay half your current HP as you draw: double the damage dice, and everything it hurts leaves you a sample

damage.doubleDice: if you pay half your current HP

offensive.name: Blood Curse
offensive.description: Your blood is weapon and vector both. What it touches, it hexes.

tiers.text: The damage becomes Sanguine, and a creature that is hit or fails is Hexed for 1 minute: once per turn when it takes damage from you or an ally, it takes extra sanguine damage equal to your Verum Modifier, and it can't regain hit points above half its maximum.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Sanguine · Hexed 1 min — +{VM} sanguine once per turn when it's hurt, and it can't heal past half its max HP

rider.when: once per turn when it takes damage from you or an ally

tiers.text: Bound in blood. If you hold a sample of its blood, the hex lasts 1 hour, can't be traced back to you, and ends only with Remove Curse or stronger magic. While Hexed it has disadvantage on saving throws against your Blood seals.
tiers.card: With its sample: the hex lasts 1 hr, untraceable, only Remove Curse ends it · Hexed: disadvantage on saves against your Blood seals

tiers.text: Blood remembers. With a sample, the hex is permanent until Greater Restoration is cast on it and the sample is destroyed. The first time each round the Hexed creature takes damage from your Blood seals, that damage is doubled.
tiers.card: With its sample, the hex is permanent until Greater Restoration AND the sample's destruction · your Blood seals deal double to it once a round

damage.double: once per round, against the Hexed creature

tiers.text: Lineage Leech. When your Blood seal damages a Hexed creature, it loses one Legendary Resistance or one use of a class feature — Action Surge, Wild Shape, a Smite — until it finishes a long rest. If you hold a relative's blood, you may spread the hex along the bloodline to every kin of the target within 1 mile.
tiers.card: LINEAGE LEECH — hurting a Hexed creature strips a Legendary Resistance or a class-feature use until its long rest · with a relative's blood, the hex spreads to its kin within 1 mile

suppress.feature: one Legendary Resistance or class-feature use

supportive.name: Blood-Healing
supportive.description: Blood remembers the shape the body was before it broke — and, given a sample, it will return there.

tiers.text: The seal's healing gains 5 hit points × the slot level, doubled if you hold a sample of the target's blood — and a sample lets the healing reach its owner at any distance on the same plane, without line of sight.
tiers.card: +5 × {SLOT} HP (double with the target's sample) · with a sample, reach its owner anywhere on the plane

heal.withSample: doubled, and any range on the plane

tiers.text: Healing through this seal ignores every penalty to healing, and ends one curse, disease, or level of Exhaustion on each target.
tiers.card: Ignores every healing penalty · ends one curse, disease or Exhaustion level on each target

cleanse: one curse, disease, or level of Exhaustion

tiers.text: The flood reaches 10 hit points × the slot level (doubled with a sample). A target that died within the last minute with its body intact — or within the last day, if you hold its sample — returns to life with the healing.
tiers.card: Now +10 × {SLOT} HP (double with a sample) · raises the dead of the last minute, or the last day with their sample

mech.revive: dead within 1 minute, or 1 day with a sample

tiers.text: Blood never forgets its owner. When a creature whose sample you hold dies, at any distance, you may use your reaction to raise it with all its hit points, missing parts restored — without drawing a seal, once per day for each sample.
tiers.card: When anyone whose sample you hold dies, anywhere: your reaction raises them at full HP, whole — no seal needed, 1/day per sample

mech.revive: reaction, at any distance, full HP, once per day per sample

supportive.name: Crimson Veil
supportive.description: A veil of glimmering blood-mist, and blood that violently refuses intrusion.

tiers.text: Blood-mist veils the target for the buff's duration: it gains temporary hit points equal to your Verum Modifier at the start of each of its turns, and the first time it would drop to 0 hit points it drops to 1 instead and the veil ends.
tiers.card: While the buff lasts: {VM} temp HP at the start of each of its turns · the first drop to 0 leaves it at 1 (and ends the veil)

tiers.text: The blood refuses intrusion. The temporary hit points become your Verum Modifier + the slot level; the first time each round a creature damages the target with a spell or seal, that creature takes sanguine damage equal to your Verum Modifier + the slot level; and the target has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, possessed, or magically compelled.
tiers.card: Temp HP becomes {VM} + {SLOT} · the first spell or seal to hurt it each round costs the caster {VM} + {SLOT} sanguine · advantage vs charm, possession and compulsion

reflect.trigger: first spell or seal each round

buff.advantage: saves against being charmed, possessed, or compelled

tiers.text: While it has temporary hit points from the veil, the target has resistance to all damage except psychic, and bleeding on it ends.
tiers.card: While the veil's temp HP hold: resistance to all damage but psychic · bleeding on it ends

buff.resist: all damage except psychic, while the veil's temp HP last

tiers.text: Crimson Tide. Once per turn, when the target damages a creature, it regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt, and the drop-to-1 protection returns at the start of each of its turns instead of ending the veil.
tiers.card: CRIMSON TIDE — 1/turn it heals half the damage it deals · the drop-to-1 protection comes back every turn

supportive.name: Blood-Bond
supportive.description: The red thread of lineage cuts across realms and mortality.

tiers.text: The seal can reach a blood relative of yours — parent, sibling, child — at any distance, even across planes.
tiers.card: Reach a blood relative at any distance, even across planes

tiers.text: If the relative is dead but its body remains, you can speak with it, or let it take one action through your body as a ghost.
tiers.card: Speak with a dead relative, or let it act once through your body

tiers.text: The bond reaches ancestors and descendants. Learn one memory, flaw, or trait from any member of the line, living or dead.
tiers.card: Reach ancestors and descendants — learn one memory, flaw or trait from the line

tiers.text: Choose one member of the bloodline, living or dead, and take up its power for 1 hour — one feature it had in life: a racial trait, a class feature, a spell, or a Cognition affinity. The seal may reach every member of that bloodline at once, whatever their state, realm, or condition.
tiers.card: Take up one feature of any bloodline member for 1 hr · the seal may reach the whole line at once

control.name: Blood Puppet
control.description: Every body is a marionette. The strings are already inside.

tiers.text: You seize the blood of a creature that fails: move it up to 15 feet in a direction you choose, and it can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Fail: you move them 15 ft where you choose · no reactions until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: Its blood locks. It is Restrained until the end of its next turn — or, if you hold its sample, for the effect's duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
tiers.card: Restrained until the end of their next turn · with their sample, for the whole duration (save again each turn)

tiers.text: Marionette. It is also Charmed by you, and on each of your turns you may use a bonus action to move it up to 15 feet and make it take one action you choose — attack, drop, open, flee.
tiers.card: MARIONETTE — also Charmed · your bonus action each turn: move them 15 ft and make them take an action you choose

mech.control: bonus action: move 15 ft and choose its action

tiers.text: Every creature that fails becomes a puppet, each one moved and commanded with the same bonus action. A puppet that breaks free with its repeat save still takes 4d10 sanguine damage as its blood tears loose.
tiers.card: Every one who fails is a puppet, all driven by one bonus action · breaking free still costs them 4d10 sanguine

control.name: Blood Oath
control.description: Magic bound in blood cannot be undone. The body keeps the promise even when the mind would not.

tiers.text: Speak an oath into a creature that fails — one prohibition, one sentence: “do not strike her”, “do not leave this room”. Until the end of its next turn, if it breaks the oath its blood rebels: it takes 1d10 sanguine damage per slot level, and the oath ends.
tiers.card: Fail: bind them with a one-sentence prohibition until the end of their next turn · breaking it costs 1d10 sanguine per slot level

tiers.text: The oath holds for 1 minute, and breaking it also gives the creature a Wound.
tiers.card: The oath holds 1 min · breaking it also gives them a Wound

tiers.text: A blood pact of 24 hours. If you hold its sample, the oath becomes its own: no charm, command, or domination can make it break it.
tiers.card: The oath holds 24 hrs · with their sample, nothing — charm, command, domination — can make them break it

tiers.text: A Perpetual Blood Oath: a year and a day. Breaking it marks the creature an Oathbreaker, visible to every god and every creature with divine sight, under a curse that only Greater Restoration and the destruction of your sample can end.
tiers.card: PERPETUAL — a year and a day · an oathbreaker is marked before every god, cursed until Greater Restoration and your sample's destruction

mech.curse: Oathbreaker, until Greater Restoration and the sample's destruction

utility.name: Red Thread
utility.description: Every drop carries the full record of a life.

tiers.text: Learn a creature's species, approximate age, and state of health from a drop of its blood. Know whether two creatures are blood kin. Preserve a blood sample indefinitely.
tiers.card: From one drop: species, age, health · tell blood kin apart · preserve a sample forever

tiers.text: Track a creature whose blood you hold, unerringly, within 1 mile. Read the last hour of a creature's life from blood spilled within the last day.
tiers.card: Track its owner within 1 mile · read the last hour of a life from day-old blood

tiers.text: Witness one scene from the life of any ancestor of the blood you hold. Send a wordless call along a blood-bond that the kin feels at any distance.
tiers.card: Witness a scene from any ancestor's life · send a wordless call the kin feels anywhere

tiers.text: Trace a bloodline in full — every living descendant of a drop you hold, where they are and what they are. Or seal an oath in blood that both parties feel break the instant it is broken, anywhere in the world.
tiers.card: Trace a whole bloodline · or seal an oath both parties feel break, anywhere in the world

complementEffects.name: Sanguine Wound
complementEffects.description: The seal doesn't just hurt — it opens something that keeps opening.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target begins bleeding: 1d6 sanguine damage at the start of each of its turns, until it or an ally spends an action to staunch it (a Medicine check against your Verum DC) or it receives magical healing.
effect.card: Bleeding — 1d6 sanguine at the start of each of their turns until staunched (Medicine {DC}) or magically healed

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.escape: an action and a Medicine check, or magical healing

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The bleeding becomes 2d6, and staunching it takes a Medicine check against your Verum DC + 2.
Level 11+: The bleeding becomes 3d6, no mundane care can close it — only magical healing — and the wound leaves you a sample of its blood.
upgrades.card: 3d6 a turn · only magical healing closes it · it leaves you a sample

complementEffects.name: Transfusion
complementEffects.description: You give of yourself so another might endure.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, you may lose up to twice your Proficiency Bonus in hit points. One ally within 30 feet regains twice what you lost.
effect.card: Lose up to 2 × {PB} HP — an ally within 30 ft regains twice that

upgrades.text: Level 5+: You may lose up to twice your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier, and the ally regains three times what you lost.
upgrades.card: Lose up to 2 × {PB} + Con · the ally regains triple

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The ally also ends one condition of your choice, and the blood you gave comes back to you: you regain what you lost at the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: It also ends one condition · you regain what you gave at the start of your next turn

complementEffects.name: Bloodline Mark
complementEffects.description: Once your blood touches them, they are known.

effect.text: A creature that is hit or fails is marked by blood for 1 hour: you always know its exact location and distance, it gains no benefit from invisibility or illusions against you, and the mark leaves you a sample of its blood.
effect.card: Marked 1 hr — you always know where they are, no invisibility or illusion against you · you take a sample

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Allies who can see the marked creature have advantage on their first attack roll against it each turn.
upgrades.card: Allies who can see them: advantage on their first attack against them each turn

buff.advantage: the first attack roll against it each turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The mark lasts 24 hours and then turns permanent until Remove Curse or Greater Restoration, and your Blood seals deal one additional sanguine damage die to the marked creature.
upgrades.card: Lasts 24 hrs, then permanent until Remove Curse or Greater Restoration · your Blood seals deal +1 die sanguine to them
